value.deck: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22, a new release candidate for self-hosted deployments, brings important AI and security enhancements, reflecting the growing trend of integrating advanced AI into enterprise development workflows.
shortVersion: GitHub has announced the release candidate for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22, its platform designed for organizations that prefer to host their code repositories and development tools on their own infrastructure. This update introduces a suite of new features and improvements specifically tailored for these self-hosted environments.

For enterprise teams, this release is particularly significant as it includes upcoming Copilot and security features, allowing them to leverage advanced AI assistance and enhanced protection within their on-premises setups. Evaluating this release candidate now is crucial for planning future upgrades and ensuring a smooth transition to these new capabilities.
value.plainLanguage: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is a new test version for companies that host their own GitHub, bringing new AI and security tools.

keyTerms.meaning: A version of GitHub designed for large organizations that want to host their code and development tools on their own servers, rather than using GitHub's cloud service.
A software version that is potentially the final product but is released for last-minute testing to catch any remaining bugs before the official public release.
Refers to software or services that an organization installs and manages on its own servers and infrastructure, giving them full control over data and security.
An AI-powered coding assistant developed by GitHub and OpenAI that suggests code snippets and functions in real-time, helping developers write code faster and more efficiently.

value.whyItMatters: For organizations already using or considering self-hosted GitHub, this release means they can soon integrate cutting-edge AI coding assistance and robust security features directly into their private infrastructure, aligning with the broader industry move towards secure, on-premises AI deployment for sensitive data.
watchNext: Keep an eye out for the official general availability release of GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22, which will follow this release candidate.
Observe how other major enterprise software providers integrate AI tools into their on-premises solutions, following GitHub's lead.
Monitor the evolving capabilities of AI coding assistants like Copilot and how they impact developer productivity and security best practices.
